description: Character pool for AniStar onboarding Option 2 (gameshow). Each character has archetype tags used to bias selection by display name vibes, and a 'represents' field that captures the emotional/psychological space they occupy. Used to seed the FF network with character preference signals.
note: mal_id fields are placeholders (null). They are not required for the gameshow itself — character matching uses the 'represents' text via CLIP embedding. If you want to link to MAL pages or fetch images, populate mal_id by looking up each character on myanimelist.net.

characters.name: Rock Lee
characters.represents: The student whose love for his teacher and his own self-imposed rules became the engine of a strength nobody believed he could earn.

characters.name: Asta
characters.represents: The boy with no magic who decided friends would be family, and refused every limit the world tried to set on him.

characters.name: Shinra Kusakabe
characters.represents: The boy who carries an impossible promise like a torch, becoming a hero because someone has to be.

characters.name: Kamina
characters.represents: The big brother who became a legend on purpose so his little brother could see what he was capable of becoming.

characters.name: Gaara
characters.represents: The child weaponized into a monster who became a voice of reason after learning what it meant to be loved.

characters.name: Natsu Dragneel
characters.represents: The dumb-looking warrior whose battle instincts are sharper than anyone expects, fueled by rage on behalf of the people he loves.

characters.name: Obito Uchiha
characters.represents: The boy who watched love be twisted into ruin, became a villain, and then died trying to save the world from what he had become.

characters.name: Anos Voldigoad
characters.anime: The Misfit of Demon King Academy
characters.represents: The original demon king who, told an imposter had taken his place, simply set about helping the imposter live up to the role.

characters.name: Kuroko Tetsuya
characters.represents: The player who couldn't shoot but became indispensable by being exactly where the ball needed to be, every single time.

characters.name: Tamaki Kotatsu
characters.represents: The girl who keeps being thrown into situations she didn't ask for and slowly learns to own herself instead of apologizing for existing.

characters.name: Yami Sukehiro
characters.represents: The captain who breaks every rule and demands the impossible because he sees what his subordinates can become before they do.

characters.name: Ken Kaneki
characters.represents: The boy and the ghoul fighting for the same body, neither of them sure which one deserves to win.

characters.name: Izuku Midoriya
characters.represents: The quirkless kid who almost gave up on his dream, then earned every inch of the future he refused to let go of.

characters.name: Kenichi Shirahama
characters.represents: The weak, scared kid who chose to face terrifying odds anyway because giving up was the one thing he wouldn't do.

characters.name: Baki Hanma
characters.represents: The son born into impossible expectations who chose to live up to them even after learning they were a lie.

characters.name: Yujiro Hanma
characters.represents: The strongest creature on earth, who became that way because being stronger than everyone was the only goal that ever made sense to him.

characters.name: Monkey D. Luffy
characters.represents: The boy who declared he would be the freest man alive and then lived every day as if that were already true.

characters.name: Sanji
characters.represents: The cook who wants to be loved more than anything because he loves more deeply than he can say.

characters.name: Roronoa Zoro
characters.represents: The swordsman who walked the lonely road of strength after losing his first love, sacrificing everything else for the promise.

characters.name: Mark Grayson
characters.represents: The boy who believed in his father completely and now has to figure out what kind of hero he can become without that lie.

characters.name: Black Star
characters.represents: The assassin's son with one goal — surpass God — who never once questioned whether the goal made sense.

characters.name: Guts
characters.represents: The man who refuses to let despair have the final word, fighting because stopping would mean the darkness was right about him.

characters.name: Eren Yeager
characters.represents: The boy who watched his world burn and turned his rage into a religion, walking forward until there was nothing left.

characters.name: Yusuke Urameshi
characters.represents: The street kid who died protecting a child in the first episode and spent the rest of his life earning the second chance he was given.

characters.name: Joseph Joestar
characters.represents: The hero who survives by being smarter, weirder, and more shameless than anyone gives him credit for.

characters.name: Meliodas
characters.represents: The sin-bearer carrying three thousand years of guilt who keeps showing up for the people he loves anyway.

characters.name: Soma Yukihira
characters.represents: The legend's son who refused to coast on his name and earned every win from scratch in the kitchen.

characters.name: Senku Ishigami
characters.represents: The genius who decided he would rebuild civilization from zero, alone if he had to, because the path didn't exist until he made it.

characters.name: Thorfinn
characters.represents: The boy who lived for vengeance and the man who has to learn how to live without it after the world he built collapses.

characters.name: Saitama
characters.represents: The hero who got the strength he wanted and lost everything that made wanting it worthwhile.

characters.name: Hyakkimaru
characters.represents: The boy born missing every part of himself, reclaiming his own body piece by piece from the demons that took it.

characters.name: Vash the Stampede
characters.represents: The gunslinger who carries impossible weight under a goofy mask and chooses kindness in a world that gave him every reason not to.

characters.name: Gon Freecss
characters.represents: The cheerful boy whose determination has a darker edge the show eventually examines with brutal honesty.

characters.name: Edward Elric
characters.represents: The boy who paid for his hubris with his body and his brother's, then spent his life trying to make it right without taking shortcuts.

characters.name: Lelouch vi Britannia
characters.represents: The cold strategist who treats people as variables and lies even to those who love him, willing to be the villain history needs.

characters.name: Light Yagami
characters.represents: The honor student who got the power of a god handed to him and used it to become the worst version of righteousness.

characters.name: Shinji Ikari
characters.represents: The boy who can't will himself forward, who breaks under the weight others carry without complaint, honest about how hard it really is.

characters.name: Okabe Rintaro
characters.represents: The mad scientist whose silly performance becomes real grief once he learns what the cost of caring actually looks like.

characters.name: Ginko
characters.represents: The wandering observer who never tries to win or surpass anyone, just witnesses the strangeness of the world and lets it be.

characters.name: Spike Spiegel
characters.represents: The bounty hunter living in the past, drifting toward an ending he already knows is waiting for him.

characters.name: Holo
characters.represents: The wolf goddess older and wiser than anyone in the room, whose strength is patience and whose loneliness is centuries deep.

characters.name: Reigen Arataka
characters.represents: The con man with no powers and no destiny who builds something genuinely real out of pure presence and ordinary decency.

characters.name: Violet Evergarden
characters.represents: The child soldier learning what love means by writing letters for other people, finding her humanity word by word.

characters.name: L Lawliet
characters.represents: Pure intellect with no heroic narrative and no growth arc, just the patient pursuit of the truth no matter what it costs.

characters.name: Shigeo 'Mob' Kageyama
characters.represents: The strongest psychic alive who actively decides his power is the least important thing about him, choosing to be ordinary on purpose.

characters.name: Osamu Dazai
characters.represents: The brilliant detective wrapped around a death wish, living sideways to every meaning he could choose.
